body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Email is Bounced in Saleshandy trigger on Production, all 9 activities:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create a Contact in HubSpot | The email shows Hard Bounced, one log entry with Success, contact created with the mapped properties (AL-4016). | Pass |
| 2 | Update a Contact in HubSpot | Workflow Success, contact shows the changed values. | Pass |
| 3 | Create a Deal in HubSpot | Deal created and associated to the contact. | Pass |
| 4 | Update a Deal in HubSpot | With 3 deals and Extra Configuration set, the latest created deal gets the configured values and the other two are unchanged. | Pass |
| 5 | Create a Company in HubSpot | One company created and associated to the contact. | Pass |
| 6 | Update a Company in HubSpot | With 2 associated companies, the latest company shows the new City and State and the other is unchanged (AL-4125). | Pass |
| 7 | Create a Task in HubSpot | Task created with the configured values. | Pass |
| 8 | Create a Note in HubSpot | Paired with Create a Deal, the note is on both the contact and the deal. | Pass |
| 9 | Record (log) an Email Activity in HubSpot | Paired with Create a Deal, the email is logged on both the contact and the deal, not as Unknown Contact. | Pass |
waitingFor: QA to check the wording and that rows 3, 5 and 7 may stay one-line. Evidence: automation/test-results-bounced-prod-smoke/ (tests 01 to 08) and test-results-bounced-prod-smoke-rerun/ (tests 00 and 09, passed on rerun after two script fixes). Run 2026-10-15, sequence 973942, account emailopenedprod.
